game.king.name: King
game.king.desc: The trick-avoidance classic: dodge every heart, the queen of spades and the king of hearts, or shoot the moon and win the deal outright.
game.king.rule.1: Follow suit when possible and avoid taking hearts, the queen of spades and the king of hearts.
game.king.rule.2: Each penalty card scores against you. Taking every penalty card shoots the moon and reverses the scores.
game.king.option.passing_hint: Each player picks three cards and passes them to the player on the left before the first trick.
game.king.option.shoot_moon_hint: A player who takes every heart and the queen of spades has those penalties waived and still keeps the king of hearts bonus.
game.king.hint: Click a card to play it. Follow the led suit while you can.
game.king.hint_passing: Click three cards to pass them to the player on your left.
game.king.status_passing: {player} picks a card to pass ({picked} of {total} picked).
game.king.status_follow: {player} plays to the trick led by {leader}.
game.king.log_start: The deal: {cards} cards each, {aside} set aside.
game.king.log_pick: {player} picks a card for the pass.
game.king.log_pass: Three cards from every player are passed to the left.
game.king.log_moon: {player} took every heart and the queen of spades!
game.king.reason.finished: The deal is complete: the fewest points wins.
game.king.error.unknown_action: That action does not belong to king.
game.king.error.illegal_action: That card cannot be played now.
